class.name: AudioStreamPlayerFluidSynth
class.description: AudioStreamPlayerFluidSynth is an [AudioStreamPlayer] whose [member AudioStreamPlayer.stream] is an [AudioStreamFluidSynth]. It owns the instance lifecycle (the inherited [method AudioStreamPlayer.play], [method AudioStreamPlayer.stop], [method AudioStreamPlayer.seek] and the [signal AudioStreamPlayer.finished] signal), the SMF transport controls, and the voice-control surface, which it forwards to the stream's synth.

method.name: program_select
method.description: Selects a SoundFont preset on [param chan] via [code]fluid_synth_program_select[/code].

method.name: note_on
method.description: Triggers note-on on [param chan] via [code]fluid_synth_noteon[/code].

method.name: note_off
method.description: Triggers note-off on [param chan] via [code]fluid_synth_noteoff[/code].

method.name: cc
method.description: Sends a control-change message on [param chan] via [code]fluid_synth_cc[/code].

method.name: pitch_bend
method.description: Sets pitch bend [param val] on [param chan] via [code]fluid_synth_pitch_bend[/code]. [param val] is in [code][0, 16383][/code] with [code]8192[/code] as center.

method.name: program_change
method.description: Sends a program-change message on [param chan] via [code]fluid_synth_program_change[/code].

method.name: bank_select
method.description: Sends a bank-select message on [param chan] via [code]fluid_synth_bank_select[/code].

method.name: sfont_select
method.description: Selects a SoundFont on [param chan] via [code]fluid_synth_sfont_select[/code].

method.name: key_pressure
method.description: Sends a key-pressure (polyphonic aftertouch) message via [code]fluid_synth_key_pressure[/code].

method.name: channel_pressure
method.description: Sends a channel-pressure message via [code]fluid_synth_channel_pressure[/code].

method.name: all_notes_off
method.description: Turns off all notes on [param chan] via [code]fluid_synth_all_notes_off[/code].

method.name: all_sounds_off
method.description: Stops all sounds on [param chan] via [code]fluid_synth_all_sounds_off[/code].

method.name: system_reset
method.description: Resets the synth via [code]fluid_synth_system_reset[/code].

method.name: get_cc
method.description: Returns the current value of controller [param ctrl] on [param chan], or [code]0[/code] if no synth is attached.

method.name: get_pitch_bend
method.description: Returns the current pitch bend value on [param chan], or [code]0[/code] if no synth is attached.

method.name: get_pitch_wheel_sens
method.description: Returns the pitch wheel sensitivity on [param chan], or [code]0[/code] if no synth is attached.

method.name: get_program
method.description: Returns the current preset number on [param chan], or [code]0[/code] if no synth is attached.

method.name: get_voice_count
method.description: Returns the number of currently active voices, or [code]0[/code] if no synth is attached.

method.name: set_loop
method.description: Sets the SMF loop count on the active player.

method.name: get_loop
method.description: Returns the SMF loop count.

method.name: get_tick
method.description: Returns the current tick of the active player, or [code]0[/code] if there is none.

method.name: get_total_ticks
method.description: Returns the total tick count of the active player, or [code]0[/code] if there is none.

method.name: get_bpm
method.description: Returns the current BPM of the active player, or [code]0[/code] if there is none.

method.name: get_division
method.description: Returns the ticks-per-quarter-note division of the active player, or [code]0[/code] if there is none.

method.name: set_tempo
method.description: Sets the tempo of the active player. [param tempo_type] is one of [code]FLUID_PLAYER_TEMPO_INTERNAL[/code], [code]FLUID_PLAYER_TEMPO_EXTERNAL_BPM[/code] or [code]FLUID_PLAYER_TEMPO_EXTERNAL_MIDI[/code].

method.name: get_tempo
method.description: Returns the current BPM of the active player as a [float], or [code]0.0[/code] if there is none.
